raw_segments.text: My journey is closed," I thought to myself. I got out of the coach, gave a box I had into
the Osler's Charge to be kept till I called for it, paid my fare, satisfied the coachman
and was going. The brightening day gleamed on the sign of the inn and I read in guilt
letters, the Rochester Arms. My heart leapt up. I was already on my master's very lands.
It fell again. The thought struck it.
